parsed.answer: For Larch’s next outage, Mara should use REPLAY-0-632, the procedure tested on August 8 that restored the missing updates. The delivery-mode change was prompted by outages at GATE-0-519; Mara approved switching Larch from BATCH-0-741 to STREAM-0-286 on August 15, and reaffirmed that delivery choice on August 22.

citations.quote: The team tested REPLAY-0-632, which restored the missing updates.
For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8.

Mara approved switching Larch from BATCH-0-741 to STREAM-0-286. This supersedes the August 1 delivery decision. The cause was the GATE-0-519 outages recorded on August 8; keep the successful recovery procedure from that incident.
